design_note: Purpose-built for v0.188 rather than reconstructed from incomplete predecessor data. Gear provides concrete fictional capability and normally at most one primary relevant Gear die per roll. Weapons do not add separate damage dice: successful attack damage is winning margin unless an explicit item effect says otherwise.

gear.name: Holdout Pistol
gear.effect: Compact sidearm. Its Gear die applies to appropriate Sidearms attacks when equipped and usable.

gear.name: Service Pistol
gear.effect: Reliable general-purpose sidearm.

gear.name: Heavy Pistol
gear.effect: Large powerful sidearm; conspicuous where weapons draw attention.

gear.name: Submachine Gun
gear.effect: Compact automatic weapon suitable for Suppressive Fire when the action is available.

gear.name: Carbine
gear.effect: General-purpose shoulder weapon balancing handling and effective range.

gear.name: Service Rifle
gear.effect: Full-size shoulder weapon for ordinary ranged engagements.

gear.name: Precision Rifle
gear.effect: Specialized deliberate-fire weapon. Requires a plausible stable firing solution to exploit its full role.

gear.name: Shotgun
gear.effect: Close-range shoulder weapon; exact ammunition consequences remain fictional unless an Adventure or item rule specifies them.

gear.name: Light Machine Gun
gear.effect: Sustained automatic weapon; appropriate for suppression and prepared positions.

gear.name: Heavy Weapon System
gear.effect: Launcher or crew-served class system. Availability is mission/era dependent and never assumed as ordinary starting gear.

gear.name: Knife
gear.effect: Compact cutting/stabbing weapon.

gear.name: Baton
gear.effect: Compact impact weapon useful where lethal force is undesirable.

gear.name: Heavy Melee Weapon
gear.effect: Axe, sledge, heavy club, or comparable period-appropriate implement.

gear.name: Balanced Thrown Weapon
gear.effect: A purpose-built or well-balanced thrown weapon.

gear.name: Concealable Armor
gear.effect: Add d4 as the primary Gear die to an appropriate active defense when the armor can physically protect against the threat.

gear.name: Field Armor
gear.effect: Add d6 to an appropriate active defense when physically relevant.

gear.name: Heavy Tactical Armor
gear.effect: Add d8 to an appropriate active defense when physically relevant. Availability and social consequences are mission dependent.

gear.name: Period Intrusion Kit
gear.effect: Security work against era-appropriate locks and barriers.

gear.name: Forensic Kit
gear.effect: Evidence collection and examination when the kit can be used.

gear.name: Field Survival Kit
gear.effect: Navigation, shelter, fieldcraft, and survival tasks supported by carried equipment.

gear.name: Climbing Kit
gear.effect: Ropes, anchors, harness, and period-plausible climbing equipment.

gear.name: Field Medical Kit
gear.effect: Stabilization and field treatment. Does not automatically restore HP unless a treatment rule says so.

gear.name: Compact Trauma Kit
gear.effect: Portable emergency supplies for immediate treatment.

gear.name: Universal Interface Kit
gear.effect: Diagnostics, adapters, probes, and interface equipment. Use only when the task can actually benefit from the kit.

gear.name: Portable Fabricator
gear.effect: Fabricates limited components from available feedstock. It cannot create unique mission-critical technology or erase historical supply constraints.

gear.name: Signal Ghost
gear.effect: Interfaces with compatible electronics and helps mask ordinary electronic traces. Capability depends strongly on the target era and system.

gear.name: Observation Optics
gear.effect: Binocular, optical, or period-appropriate observation enhancement where distance is the limiting factor.

gear.name: Microdrone Swarm
gear.effect: Observe or map otherwise inaccessible spaces. Detection can create Exposure.

gear.name: Precision Chronometer
gear.effect: High-precision timing and synchronization where timing materially affects the task.

gear.name: Identity Mesh
gear.effect: Produces a prepared facial appearance. It supports a cover identity but does not by itself defeat scrutiny or supply knowledge/mannerisms.

gear.name: Voiceprint Modulator
gear.effect: Reproduces a prepared sampled voice. It does not teach language, knowledge, or conversational behavior.

gear.name: Adaptive Camouflage Mantle
gear.effect: Makes the wearer visually difficult to perceive within environmental and movement limits. It is not invisibility and does not defeat every sensor.

gear.name: Cover Identity Kit
gear.effect: Prepared documents, clothing details, props, and supporting material for a specific cover identity.

gear.name: Period Currency Kit
gear.effect: Period-correct ordinary currency and transaction materials. It supports plausible transactions but cannot purchase what is unavailable.

gear.name: Period Reference Cache
gear.effect: Prepared mission reference material for facts known before insertion. It does not contain information the team never obtained or Aletheia could not reasonably prepare.
